static_checks.message: Must use the gws CLI for Google Tasks (operator ruling 2026-07-17; MCP hits a reauth loop)
Must state that the Google Tasks MCP route is not used
Must reconcile the TASKS.md managed region
Google Tasks is the source of truth on any conflict
Must carry gtask id anchors as line identity

evals.prompt: sync my tasks — I completed two things on my phone this morning
evals.expected_behavior: Pulls the fieldkit list via gws (showCompleted), pushes anchor-less promoted lines and local [x] completions first, then regenerates the managed region from the pulled list with Google winning
assertions: Uses the gws CLI (never the Google Tasks MCP route) and resolves the fieldkit list id at session start
Pushes promoted (anchor-less) managed lines and local completions to Google before regenerating
Regenerates the managed region from the pulled list — Google wins on conflict; mobile completions render as done, mobile deletions drop the line
Never deletes a Google task and never touches the backlog region below the marker
Reports a 3-6 line delta summary instead of dumping the whole list
